title: Functorial additive raw cohomology pullback
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, $k:W\to S$ a scheme morphism, $G$ a $\Lambda$-module sheaf on $W_{\mathrm{et}}$, $q\in\mathbf Z$, and $U\to S$ an etale object. Write $P_A(U)$ and $r_f:P_B(U)\to P_A(U)$ for the raw groups and explicit pullbacks of [sbc-lem-higher-image-raw-over-naturality]. For every morphism $f:A\to B$ in $\mathrm{Over}(W)$, $r_f(0)=0$ and $r_f(x+y)=r_f(x)+r_f(y)$. For every $A$, $r_{\mathrm{id}_A}=\mathrm{id}_{P_A(U)}$. For composable $f:A\to B$ and $g:B\to C$, $r_{g\circ f}=r_f\circ r_g$. There are no limit or quasi-compactness hypotheses.

proof.text: Preservation of zero and addition is proved in Lean using generic five-factor zero and addition lemmas, with Functor.map_zero, Functor.map_add and bilinearity of composition. No further project theorem is needed.

Apply [lem-sbc-higher-image-raw-pullback-identity] to the identity clause. The zero and addition clauses have already been proved from the explicit five-factor expression, so this is strictly one remaining part of the conjunction.
Apply [lem-sbc-higher-image-raw-pullback-composition] for the remaining composition clause. Assemble the four clauses with conjunction constructors.

lean.statement: theorem higherDirectImageRawOverPullback_functorial (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {W S : Scheme.{u}} (k : W ⟶ S) (G : Sheaf W.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (q : ℤ) (U : S.Etale) : (∀ (A B : Over W) (f : A ⟶ B), higherDirectImageRawOverPullback Λ k G q f U 0 = 0) ∧ (∀ (A B : Over W) (f : A ⟶ B) (x y : (higherDirectImageRawOverPresheaf Λ k G q B).obj (op U)), higherDirectImageRawOverPullback Λ k G q f U (x + y) = higherDirectImageRawOverPullback Λ k G q f U x + higherDirectImageRawOverPullback Λ k G q f U y) ∧ (∀ (A : Over W) (z : (higherDirectImageRawOverPresheaf Λ k G q A).obj (op U)), higherDirectImageRawOverPullback Λ k G q (𝟙 A) U z = z) ∧ (∀ (A B C : Over W) (f : A ⟶ B) (g : B ⟶ C) (z : (higherDirectImageRawOverPresheaf Λ k G q C).obj (op U)), higherDirectImageRawOverPullback Λ k G q (f ≫ g) U z = higherDirectImageRawOverPullback Λ k G q f U (higherDirectImageRawOverPullback Λ k G q g U z))
